title: Work IQ: agents select the most relevant skills for each request
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, published licensing rules, and package-management paths and API calls are supported. The revised governance documentation still supports the package-level controls, without establishing how this roadmap feature selects skills. The related business-skills description should flag its preview status.
